name: vllm_shuffle_rows
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_shuffle_rows.py. Gathers/expands rows of input_tensor (src_rows,cols) into an output (dst_rows,cols) according to dst2src_map (dst_rows,) int32 whose entries are source-row indices in [0,src_rows). Reference calls vLLM _custom_ops.shuffle_rows and returns the new tensor (not in-place). gen_inputs builds dst2src_map as a randperm when dst_rows==src_rows>1 (pure shuffle) and randint(0,src_rows) otherwise (expansion with repeats), matching the test. dtype in {fp16,bf16}. Default PyTree comparison validates the output element-wise. Requires vLLM at eval time.
